correctness.rationale: For bidirected K_{2,q}, q>=6, every multipath has at most four arcs because each of two left vertices has in/out degree ≤1. Counting all admissible orientations gives f-vector (4q,6q²−4q,4q(q−1)²,q(q−1)²(q−2)) and Euler characteristic yielding B_q=q⁴−8q³+19q²−14q+1. The proof partitions faces by external arcs after six probe columns; every external face uses ≤4 external right vertices, so the four-named-external-column fiber check covers every q symbolically. Independently reconstructed and reran all 312 nonempty external patterns and every directed matching Hasse edge (8,904 tested nonempty fiber cells total); the critical profiles matched 16·71, 56·19, 24·25, 144·5, 72·1 cells in the stated sizes and every fiber topological sort succeeded. Replayed the six-column base (1,416 simplices, 623 pairs, one critical vertex and 169 three-cells) and independently checked mod-two low-q boundary ranks q=2..5. By the patchwork lemma, the global matching is acyclic and has one 0-cell and only 3-cells, so the entire q>=6 integral homotopy type is the asserted S³ wedge; low-q non-two-connectedness is exact, not timeout-based.
